findings.description: Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc had a daughter, Antonia, born 15 August 1877 and baptised 29 October 1877 at San Pedro Carchá, Alta Verapaz, Guatemala; the baptism register image names her parents as Salvador [Choc] and Petrona [Choc] and her godparents as Manuel Tiul and Mª Santos; the FamilySearch index misdates the birth as '1581' (indexing error for 1877).

target_person.name: Antonia Choc

details.mother: Petrona Choc, bride of the 9 August 1871 marriage

supporting_sources: Guatemala, Catholic Church Records, 1581-2023 — index entry for Antonia, daughter of Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc, born 15 August 1877 / baptised 29 October 1877 at San Pedro Carchá, Alta Verapaz; index misdates birth as '1581' (indexing error for 1877) (ark:/61903/1:1:XS7R-WRSY)

San Pedro Carchá baptism register, June 1877–August 1878, image 149 of 407 (ark:/61903/3:1:3QHJ-M745-8H2G): entry for Antonia, born 'quince de Agosto' [15 August] 1877, baptised 29 October 1877, daughter of Salvador [Choc] and Petrona [Choc], godparents Manuel Tiul and Mª Santos — image-confirmed dates and parentage

San Pedro Carchá marriage register, 9 August 1871 (ark:/61903/1:1:FL48-S1R): Salvador Choc and Petrona Choc (Petrona Ba) married — establishes Petrona Choc as Salvador's 1871 wife (GG1G-697), distinguishing her from Petrona Xol (MGDD-Z43)
